summary: Three Southern California hunters were overcome by carbon monoxide in their tent on Moffat County Road 17 Sunday morning; Lonnie Anderegg, 78, was pronounced dead on the scene, while his son Lonnie Anderegg Jr., 53, and Jack Humphrey, 53, were taken to The Memorial Hospital in Craig and then a Denver-area hospital for CO poisoning. Officials responding at noon Sunday found the tent with two heat sources, including a propane heater.
notes: Incident Sunday 2014-11-16 (Sunday-verified); reported 2014-11-17. Sheriff/EMS response to a hunting camp; MCSO Lt. KC Hume cited. Original reporting was CraigDailyPress.com (no longer live); source on file is a CDP repost. Scope: tent-camp fatality with official response, id-3240 precedent.
